Blocks.Section: Sync Pipeline Stages
Blocks.Text: Pipeline Stages should be sent via the Middleware Platform whenever a new stage is created or an existing stage is updated in your CRM. When a customer activates CRM Connect for the first time, you must sync all of their historical data to LinkedIn to power the integration.

Blocks.Section: Sync Pipeline Stages via Batch Update
SectionPath: Sync Pipeline Stages via Batch Update
Blocks.Text: Perform HTTP PUT on the /tcrmPipelineStages endpoint to send talent CRM pipeline stages to LinkedIn. Batch requests require the x-restli-method: batch_update header. Multiple records can be sent in a single API request as indicated in the example below.

Blocks.Section: Sync Pipeline Stages via Batch Update
SectionPath: Sync Pipeline Stages via Batch Update
Blocks.Text: Perform HTTP PUT on the /pipelineStages endpoint to send talent CRM pipeline stages to LinkedIn. Batch requests require the x-restli-method: batch_update header. Multiple records can be sent in a single API request as indicated in the example below.

Rows.Text: The category of the stage for this pipeline. Must be one of these stage categories: NURTURELEADCONTACTEDREPLIEDAPPLIEDSCREENINTERVIEWOFFERHIREDREJECTEDDECLINEDARCHIVEDOTHER
The details of the stage for this pipeline.
The time at which the pipeline stage was created within external system. Number of milliseconds since midnight January 1 1970 UTC. It must be a positive number.
The time at which the pipeline stage was last modified within external system. Number of milliseconds since midnight January 1 1970 UTC. It must be a positive number.

Blocks.Section: Delete Pipeline Stages

Blocks.Text: Perform HTTP DELETE on the /tcrmPipelineStages endpoint when a customer deletes pipeline stage records.

Blocks.Section: Delete Pipeline Stages
SectionPath: Delete Pipeline Stages
Blocks.Text: Perform HTTP DELETE on the /pipelineStages endpoint when a customer deletes pipeline stage records.

Blocks.Section: Sample Delete Pipeline Stages Request
SectionPath: Delete Pipeline Stages
Sample Delete Pipeline Stages Request
Blocks.Text:
curl -i -X DELETE "https://api.linkedin.com/v2/tcrmPipelineStages?ids%5B0%5D.tcrmPipelineId=tcrmPipelineid1000&ids%5B0%5D.integrationContext=urn:li:organization:1234567890&ids%5B0%5D.dataProvider=PARTNER&ids%5B0%5D.tcrmStageId=tcrmStageId1001&ids%5B1%5D.tcrmPipelineId=tcrmPipelineid2000&ids%5B1%5D.integrationContext=urn:li:organization:1234567890&ids%5B1%5D.dataProvider=PARTNER&ids%5B1%5D.tcrmStageId=tcrmStageId2002" \
-H 'Accept:application/json' \
-H 'X-RestLi-Protocol-Version:1.0.0' \
--header 'Authorization: Bearer {access_token}'
